effect_mechanism: These are the costs of establishing a hectare of mangrove, mostly by planting. A global database of 249 projects gives a median of $8,143 per hectare, with the middle range of projects between $1,434 and $47,935 [ev_project_cost_goto25_1], an earlier global meta-analysis gives a median of 1,097.16 USD/ha [ev_project_cost_su21_1], and a global cost-carbon study uses an average of US$4368 per hectare [ev_project_cost_jakovac20_3]. Country figures include 427.38 USD/ha (Bangladesh) and 150.00 USD/ha (Philippines) from practitioner records [ev_project_cost_wocat_4300_2019_establishment, ev_project_cost_wocat_578_2016_establishment], US$211/ha for community reforestation in the Philippines and US$946/ha in Thailand [ev_project_cost_hernmel17_4, ev_project_cost_hernmel17_3], 843 US dollars in northern Viet Nam [ev_project_cost_ifrc11_1], about USD 3,550 in Indonesia [ev_project_cost_wbidn22_1], and a modelled 7,700 USD/ha mean for Bangladesh [ev_project_cost_wbmang25_1].
conditionality: Costs vary enormously with the site and method, from simple planting of seedlings to rebuilding badly eroded coasts [ev_project_cost_su21_1, ev_project_cost_goto25_1]. Figures use different bases: some state no price year, the global database uses 2022 international dollars [ev_project_cost_goto25_1], the Indonesia figure is a government cost estimate [ev_project_cost_wbidn22_1], the Bangladesh mean is modelled [ev_project_cost_wbmang25_1], and a Mexican figure of US$94.68/ha reflects the budget available rather than the full cost, which the authors judged too low for success [ev_project_cost_hernmel17_1]. For lower-middle-income countries the figures run from about 211 to 7,700 dollars per hectare [ev_project_cost_hernmel17_4, ev_project_cost_wocat_4300_2019_establishment, ev_project_cost_wbmang25_1].

effect_mechanism: The only unit is a project cited second-hand from a Tabasco, Mexico, report, where 50 ha of black mangrove were reforested successfully at a full per-hectare cost covering sanitation, dredging, soil conservation works, ridge restoration, staff training, plant production, transplanting and monitoring [ev_project_cost_hernmel17_2].
conditionality: This is a description of what restoration cost, not a measured saving, so no direction or class is stated for cost reduction. It is a single second-hand project report from an upper-middle-income setting; a second independent source or a measured cost comparison is what is missing, and the source's printed per-hectare value could not be used as a magnitude.

effect_mechanism: Recurrent costs are compiler-entered annual maintenance costs for mangrove plantations on WOCAT sheets: 241.07 USD per hectare per year for mangrove afforestation in Bangladesh and 20.00 for mangrove buffers in the Philippines [ev_project_cost_wocat_4300_2019_maintenance, ev_project_cost_wocat_578_2016_maintenance].
conditionality: Both are WOCAT compiler entries converted from local currency and they differ widely; only the Bangladesh figure falls in the lower-middle-income band used for the class, and neither sheet itemises the maintenance tasks.
